answer: Timber-census bond stops fakes: one timber plot per identity, a sable-stamped survey filed, a 70-credit bond locked; k-th 38+6(k-1). Each epoch a pulse names random plots; holders answer a fresh timber count, and a sable auditor re-measures them. A copied survey or twice-filed plot burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool; a rented-census ring loses money. An honest agent pays 38 once, keeps bond and share.
